name: The Great Stair
legend: # = wall, . = floor, P = player start, D = door slot (in the outer wall), C = chest, S = rest shrine
waves_note: Enemies arrive in waves: the next wave comes when 1 enemy (or none) is left.
artProps: Layout copied from keepers-hall. Theme and props from the giants-steps draft room "great-stair". A giant staircase rising on the top wall, each step bigger than the last; the Giant sits on the lowest step.
signs: Tall steps? Take them one at a time.
Even a giant likes a kind word.
